entries.title: II Samuel 23:1
segments: ¶Now these are the last words of David: David the son of Jesse saith, And the man who was raised up on high, The anointed of the God of Jacob, And the sweet psalmist of Israel saith,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:2
segments: The Spirit of Jehovah spoke by me, And his word was on my tongue.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:3
segments: The God of Israel said, The Rock of Israel spoke to me, The ruler among men shall be just, Ruling in the fear of God;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:4
segments: And [he shall be] as the light of the morning, [like] the rising of the sun, A morning without clouds; [When] from the sunshine, after rain, The green grass springeth from the earth.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:5
segments: Although my house be not so before *God, Yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, Ordered in every way and sure; For [this is] all my salvation, and every desire, Although he make [it] not to grow.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:6
segments: But [the sons] of Belial [are] all of them as thorns thrust away, Because they cannot be taken with hands;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:7
segments: And the man that will touch them provideth himself with iron and the staff of a spear; And they shall be utterly burned with fire in [their] place.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:8
segments: ¶These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Joseb-Bassebeth, Tachkemonite the chief of the captains: he was Adino the Eznite; he [fought] against eight hundred, slain [by him] at one time.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:9
segments: And after him, Eleazar the son of Dodo the son of an Ahohite: he was one of the three mighty men with David, when they had defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone up.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:10
segments: He arose and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave to the sword; and Jehovah wrought a great deliverance that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:11
segments: And after him, Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite: the Philistines were gathered into a troop, and there was there a plot of ground full of lentils, and the people had fled before the Philistines;

entries.title: II Samuel 23:12
segments: and he stood in the midst of the plot and delivered it, and smote the Philistines, and Jehovah wrought a great deliverance.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:13
segments: And three of the thirty chiefs went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam, when the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:14
segments: And David was then in the stronghold; and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:15
segments: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me to drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is in the gate!

entries.title: II Samuel 23:16
segments: And the three mighty men broke through the camp of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, which is in the gate, and took it, and brought it to David; however he would not drink of it, but poured it out to Jehovah.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:17
segments: And he said, Be it far from me, Jehovah, that I should do this thing! is it not the blood of the men that went at the risk of their lives? Therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:18
segments: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was the chief of three; and he brandished his spear against three hundred and slew them; and he had a name among the three.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:19
segments: Was he not most honourable of three? and he was their captain; but he did not attain to the [first] three.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:20
segments: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, son of a valiant man, great in exploits, of Kabzeel: he it was that smote two lions of Moab; and he went down and smote a lion in the midst of a pit on a snowy day.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:21
segments: He also smote the Egyptian, an imposing man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:22
segments: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and he had a name among the three mighty men.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:23
segments: He was honoured above the thirty, but he did not attain to the [first] three. And David set him in his council.

entries.title: II Samuel 23:24
segments: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:25
segments: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:26
segments: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:27
segments: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:28
segments: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:29
segments: Heleb the son of Baanah, the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:30
segments: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:31
segments: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:32
segments: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:33
segments: Shammah the Ararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:34
segments: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:35
segments: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:36
segments: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:37
segments: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armour-bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:38
segments: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

entries.title: II Samuel 23:39
segments: Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.
